items.title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
items.description: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.description: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat.  Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Review financial dimensions when approving expenses on mobile
items.description: Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Track mileage expenses using kilometers
items.description: Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requireme

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC
items.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
items.description: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel packing slips for stocked item requirements
items.description: This feature supports controlled returns and packing slip cancellations for stocked item requirements originating in Finance and Supply Chain Management. You can open the Packing slip journal from the Item requirements page and cancel packing slips for eligible independent item requirements. Packing slip posting performs the physical inventory update while deferring the financial update, allowing cancellation before invoicing or finalization. Cancellation reverses the project cost, returns the i

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard
items.description: Customers can now view reporting for agents from third-party platforms in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). This expanded coverage provides a more comprehensive view of agent activity across their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Audio Overview updates in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Tenant-level dashboard for Interpreter
items.description: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience. Admins now have a dedicated dashboard in the Teams Admin Center to view Interpreter usage across their organization. Track adoption and usage trends in one place to better understand how Interpreter is being used.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Securi

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
items.description: Meeting organizers can now easily delete meeting generated content including recording, transcript, AI summary, and notes through the new delete button in recap page. Shared files in the meeting won't be deleted.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.description: Centralized notification settings streamline channel notification setup and management. Available in Teams settings, users have a single place to review and adjust notifications for all visible channels, instead of managing each individually.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Outlook: Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot available in Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac
items.description: We will be adding declarative agents support in Copilot Chat in Outlook. This roadmap item tracks availability in Outlook for Mac.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls.  Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
items.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
items.description:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.
This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across th

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Updated horizontal tab appearance
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing an updated horizontal tab-strip appearance on Windows and macOS. The treatment uses rounded tabs with revised spacing and aligns related tab-strip controls with the refreshed browser-frame design. Tab behavior and enterprise data handling remain unchanged. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
items.description: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
items.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
items.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
items.description: A new export functionality will be introduced in two locations: the Data Loss Prevention > Policies page and the Information Protection > Label publishing policies page. This feature will allow users to export their existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a downloadable ZIP file. The exported file can be attached to support tickets to accelerate troubleshooting.

items.title: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
items.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every chan

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
items.description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s)
items.description: Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s).

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Overview of recent comments and changes in Word
items.description: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

items.title: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
items.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.
